description: This file defines a custom Spark Streaming receiver that connects to a socket, reads text data line by line, and processes it within a Spark Streaming context. It includes the main application object 'CustomReceiver' and the class 'CustomReceiver' implementing the socket connection logic.

classes.name: CustomReceiver
classes.description: A Spark Streaming receiver that connects to a specified socket host and port, reads incoming text data line by line, and stores it for processing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method that sets up Spark Streaming context, creates a socket receiver stream, processes text data into word counts, and starts the streaming context.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts a new thread to initiate socket data reception when the receiver starts.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup logic when the receiver stops; currently does nothing.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection, reads lines until stopped, and handles reconnection or errors.
